Wait, maybe the diamond's movement is different — does the diamond move 3 cells per step? No, in the earlier "DOWN, DOWN" the diamond moved from (30,39) to (36,39) — 6 rows for 2 steps = 3 per step! So the diamond is at (9,36). Target (9,18): need LEFT×6 (18 columns).
